# Auth (web)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`sign-in`](../../flows/sign-in/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

The sign-in of reader accounts on the public site: credentials, then the TOTP or emailed code ([sign-in flow](../../flows/sign-in/FLOW.md)). Today's web calls cms-api from the browser (D14); D21 (feature web-bff-hardening, not built yet) moves every browser call to the BFF under `/bff/v1`, so this module changes then ([web rules](../../apps/web/RULES.md)).

## Techniques

Client components (`'use client'`). The dialog content unmounts on close, so each opening starts clean. Every failure maps to one alert: a credential failure gives one generic message (no account enumeration), 429 says how long to wait, a privileged account is refused. Emailed codes are sent once on mount (a ref survives the StrictMode double mount).

## Technologies

React, react-hook-form with Zod, the session feature's API.

## Entry points

Facade `index.ts`: `WebLoginDialog` (opened from the account menu).

## Where to change what

Alert texts and mapping: `LoginAlerts.rules.ts` and the web copy module. The calls: `features/session` (`Auth.api.ts`).
